deviations.no_graph: ID-token claims only; no Graph, UserInfo or profile scripts for Microsoft
deviations.email_verification: Microsoft false/absent even if email_verified supplied; changed address cannot inherit true; no fallback to UPN/preferred_username
deviations.organizations_only: useCommonEndpoint true selects organizations, accepts every organizational tenant, rejects consumer tenant and tenant_domain; no allowlist inferred
deviations.identity_encoding: Local tid:oid multitenant design differs from SDK common endpoint sub requirement; no legacy Auth0 migration parity
deviations.no_legacy_conversion: No guessed Live/Graph ID conversion; read-only startup preflight refuses preexisting unindexed Microsoft identities; migration 0021 unchanged
deviations.public_cloud_only: No sovereign cloud, B2C, v1, WS-Fed, custom endpoints/signing keys or certificate auth
deviations.secret_post: Exactly client_secret_post, advertised by discovery; other advertised methods unused
deviations.no_email_linking: Missing email supported; email/domain never identity key, authorization or implicit merge/link
deviations.google_unchanged: Preserve sub case and existing configuration; Gmail, Workspace hd and non-Gmail Google accounts; no google-apps or domain restriction
deviations.immutable_binding: Strategy/client ID/mode/normalized tenant/pinned issuer immutable; credential rotation allowed; PATCH replaces nonsecret options
deviations.capability_preflight: MicrosoftFederationSupporter capability required for Microsoft data/startup, creation/enablement/seed/import/mutations/attempts; absent/RPC Unimplemented/failure unsupported; no failed-success caching; drain old writers
deviations.bounded_network: Public pinned IPs; no redirects/proxy; 10s request, 30s callback, 1MiB response, 100 keys, 64KiB token/profile; fixture injection test-only
deviations.strict_jwk_issuer: Microsoft-only exact issuer template exception; raw key issuer required; one unambiguous eligible RS256 key; generic OIDC unchanged
deviations.no_assurance_translation: Reject prompt/claims/acr_values/max_age and map aliases for all values; no upstream MFA/reauth assurance claims
deviations.token_projection: Sealed tenant/connection/identity-bound tokens; individual GetUser requires read:users + read:user_idp_tokens; list/export/link/unlink omit; no-store
deviations.metadata_only: Unknown nonessential Extra bounded/stored-only; unsupported security requirements rejected before inert storage
deviations.profile_sync: Existing policies; never_on_login provisions initially locally; only typed present email/name/given_name/family_name; no roles/groups/app_metadata
deviations.no_refresh_guarantee: No offline_access, scheduling, Token Vault, federated logout/revocation

security.issuer: HTTPS login.microsoftonline.com/{tid}/v2.0 exact canonical lowercase GUID tid; template exact only; single directory CAS-pins concrete issuer; organizations requires template and never pins first tenant
security.keys: Pinned JWKS RS256; preserve issuer; concrete issuer exact or exact template expansion; consumer key restricted; reject token keys/URLs, none/HS256, invalid kid/alg/use, ambiguity
security.tenant: Personal tid 9188040d-6c67-4c5b-b112-36a304b66dad only; waad excludes it; guest belongs to verified resource tenant; oid lowercase GUID, sub remains required
security.claims: Signature before claim trust; ver 2.0, iss/tid/key chain, audience/azp, exp/iat/nbf, nonce, sub, optional at_hash; 60s skew; never use unverified claims for network or identities
security.endpoints: HTTPS exact host/default port; no credentials/fragments; authority oauth2/v2.0 authorize/token paths; only common or authority discovery/v2.0/keys without query; code/query S256 independent state/nonce
security.cache: tenant/immutable connection/revision/authority policy/JWKS URL; <=5min TTL, <=256 entries, one coalesced unknown-kid refresh
security.ownership: Transactional (local tenant, immutable connection ID, normalized subject); exact connection prefix stripping; reject malformed imports before writes; no user/token writes before validation
security.revision: Effective authentication/credential/enabled-client change advances FederationRevision, invalidates attempts; transaction rechecks user/config/epoch and state/cookie/origin/tenant; no network in transaction
